title: Local lower bound at a point of differentiability with injective derivative (parent Steps 3–4)
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, let ℝⁿ := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) with its Euclidean norm |·|, and let F be a real normed vector space (F : Type with NormedAddCommGroup F and NormedSpace ℝ F) with norm |·|. Let f : ℝⁿ → F and w ∈ ℝⁿ. Suppose f is (Fréchet) differentiable at w and its derivative Df(w) = fderiv ℝ f w : ℝⁿ → F is injective. Then there exists c > 0 such that c·|u| ≤ |f(w + u) − f(w)| for every u ∈ ℝⁿ with |u| ≤ c.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) {F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → F) (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)), DifferentiableAt ℝ f w → Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ f w) → ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), ‖u‖ ≤ c → c * ‖u‖ ≤ ‖f (w + u) - f w‖
